notes.zh: 新增连接状态指示：插件详情页与设置页标题旁显示彩色状态灯（EPLAN 已连接 / 已启动未连上 / 未运行 / 状态未知），每 5 秒由宿主用 tasklist + netstat 按 PID 反查 remoting 端口探测，经 GET /api-eplan/connection 下发。修复代理导致 EPLAN MCP 连不上：启动器在 python 之前清空 HTTP_PROXY/HTTPS_PROXY/ALL_PROXY 等 9 个变量。附带 dsh-auth cookie 清理脚本（退出 DSH 后运行），用于修复随机端口导致 cookie 累积、Cookie 头超过 Node 16 KB 上限而报 Web authentication failed 的问题。
notes.en: Added a live connection indicator: a coloured status light on the plugin detail page and the settings heading (EPLAN connected / started but MCP down / not running / unknown), refreshed every 5 seconds by a host-side probe that maps EPLAN.exe PIDs to their listening remoting port with tasklist + netstat and is served over GET /api-eplan/connection. Fixed EPLAN MCP connection failures behind a proxy: the launcher now clears HTTP_PROXY/HTTPS_PROXY/ALL_PROXY and six other variables before python starts. Added a dsh-auth cookie cleanup script (run with DSH closed) for the random-port cookie accumulation that overran Node's 16 KB header limit and failed the welcome handshake with Web authentication failed.

notes.zh: 新增「版本记录」：插件详情页显示版本徽标、历史发布记录、检查更新与「更新到新版本」按钮；检测到新版本时显示「可更新」标记。本地 link 安装的更新通过 Git 快进（远端领先时）或对齐已检出的发布完成，更新后需停用再启用插件。
notes.en: Added version records: the plugin detail page now shows the version badge, release history, a check-for-updates control and an Update to a new version button, with an Update available badge when a newer release is detected. For the local link install, an update fast-forwards git when the remote is ahead or finalises the checked-out release; disable and re-enable the plugin afterwards.

notes.zh: 首个正式版本：EPLAN Electric P8 2025 集成（eplan-mcp v1.3.0）、五套离线文档索引（2025 .NET API / 2025 平台手册 / 2026 / 2027 / EEC Pro）、安装路径设置页以及五套技能。
notes.en: First release: EPLAN Electric P8 2025 integration (eplan-mcp v1.3.0), five offline documentation indexes (2025 .NET API / 2025 platform help / 2026 / 2027 / EEC Pro), the install-path settings page and five skills.
